note: The roster is a CHARTER, not a monitor. Each row declares what an agent may and may not do. Liveness is claimed ONLY where it is derived from committed data — a hand-typed 'last seen' is the same lie as a hand-typed canvas label.

agents.name: The loop
agents.does: Takes one queued document, runs perceive → decide → act → evaluate → adapt, writes a redacted artifact and a graded vault event.
agents.cannot: Commit. Send anything. See this repository.

agents.name: GATEKEEPER
agents.does: Runs the redaction gate, its tests, the drift gate, a ledger floor check and the build, on a server rather than on one laptop's git config.
agents.cannot: Run the by-name deny-list — it is gitignored. Green here is not "the names ran".

agents.name: PULSE
agents.does: Reads loop-status.json and delivers one line a day — days since the last pass, queue depth, doc types — always stamped with when the snapshot was taken.
agents.cannot: See the loop host, the vault or the Mac. Stay silent on a quiet day: an unchanged number is the signal.

agents.name: SENTINEL
agents.does: Compares what production serves against what this repository committed, and reports both values with their sources when they disagree.
agents.cannot: Fix anything it finds. Speak when they match — silence is its normal output.

agents.name: HERALD
agents.does: Drafts the launch surface — nothing else.
agents.cannot: Send. Ever. Every draft queues for a human. It stays dark until the loop has produced enough to describe honestly.

agents.name: The hands
agents.does: Reaches the loop host, the vault and the working tree. Closes what no cloud agent can reach, and commits after a human reads the diff.
agents.cannot: Persist. Every session ends when the terminal closes — which is why the roster and the status file are files, not memories.

agents.name: The scout
agents.does: Held the watch roles for one day and named its own limits honestly, including the ones that ended its usefulness here.
agents.cannot: Reach the loop host either. Its roles now run as scheduled cloud agents, beside the repository they watch.
